description: host_ip and sensor_ip are IPv4 addresses
multicast_ip is empty or a multicast address
data_port, gnss_port and packet_mtu_size are integers of at least 0
udp_socket_receive_buffer_size_bytes is at least 256
cloud_min_angle and cloud_max_angle are integers from 0 to 360
The FoV may cross 0 deg (e.g. 270 to 90)
The output point cloud has exactly the configured FoV
cut_angle is in (cloud_min_angle, cloud_max_angle], or [0, 360) for 360 deg FoV, and sets scan timing as in the examples table
sync_angle is an integer from 0 to 359
rotation_speed is one of the supported RPM values
via_gap_test_cases: TC-SCH-010, TC-SCH-011, TC-SCH-012, TC-SCH-013, TC-SCH-014, TC-SCH-015, TC-SCH-019, TC-SCH-018, TC-RUN-001, TC-DIAG-001

description: return_mode is one of the 7 XT32 values

description: ptp_profile is 1588v2, 802.1as or automotive
ptp_domain is an integer from 0 to 127
802.1as and automotive use only L2 transport
ptp_lock_threshold is an integer from 1 to 100 microseconds
Hardware monitor: locked is OK, tracking is WARNING, frozen and free run are ERROR
min_range and max_range are numbers of at least 0
dual_return_distance_threshold is from 0.01 to 0.5
Point cloud publish rate is OK, WARN or ERROR by the configured bounds
via_gap_test_cases: TC-SCH-010, TC-SCH-011, TC-SCH-012, TC-SCH-013, TC-SCH-014, TC-SCH-015, TC-SCH-019, TC-DIAG-001, TC-DIAG-002, TC-DIAG-003

direct_test_cases: TC-SCH-010, TC-SCH-011, TC-SCH-012, TC-SCH-013, TC-SCH-014, TC-SCH-015, TC-SCH-019

description: rotation_speed allowed values differ across three places
ptp_lock_threshold applicability differs between docs and code
additionalProperties at "/**" level has no effect
multicast_ip pattern accepts any string
cut_angle range depends on FoV but is checked alone
PTP transport rule is documented as a restriction but handled as auto-correction
Ports and MTU have no upper bound while code uses uint16_t
min_range and max_range are optional, unordered, with differing defaults
rotation_speed and diagnostics rate bounds must change together
num_frame_transition default differs between schema and code
"Dual" return mode means different modes per model
Degenerate FoV settings are not defined
diag_span has no unit
Schema defaults are strings for numeric and boolean types
